definitions.explanation: The tangible result or product of work, especially in business, project management, or research contexts.

examples.japanese: {成果物|せいかぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成果物|せいかぶつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{完成|かんせい}させる。
examples.english: The project deliverables will be completed by next week.

examples.japanese: ⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成果物|せいかぶつ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{本|ぽん}⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Three papers were published as outputs of the research.

notes:
USAGE:
A business and project management term widely used in corporate Japan. Refers to any tangible output — documents, reports, software, prototypes, etc. Common in meetings, progress reports, and contracts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成果物|せいかぶつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit a deliverable)
- {成果物|せいかぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧ (quality of deliverables)
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧{成果物|せいかぶつ} (final deliverable)
- {成果物|せいかぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{納品|のうひん}→納品：05134_nouhin⟧ (delivery of work products)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧: result, achievement — broader term for outcomes, not necessarily tangible
- {納品物|のうひんぶつ}: delivered goods — focuses on the delivery aspect
